confirmedFindings.title: Default Clock Rate Change Causes G.711 Timestamp Drift
confirmedFindings.body: Setting default clockRate to 48000 Hz breaks narrowband G.711 streams instantiated without explicit clock rate in rtpPacketHandler.ts, causing RTP timestamp intervals to be miscalculated by 6x and creating severe audio underruns.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Dynamically set clockRate based on negotiated codec (8000 for G.711, 48000 for Opus).
